# manual capture: Compiler Explorer probes, for issue #3377
# harness:  ce-probe.py   (re-runnable: `python ce-probe.py <compiler-id> <shader> "<args>"`)
# ran:      2026-08-07
# NOTE:     hand-driven capture, not a probe of the primary repro. Not scored by match.json.
#           CE runs RELEASE builds and its DXC panes are Linux builds, so a crash there shows
#           as a POSIX signal (SIGSEGV = 139), not as a Windows status code.
#
# WHY
# Two decisions rest on this file.
#
# 1. The published link (godbolt.txt) carries only the two DXC panes and NO Clang pane.
#    SKILL.md asks for a Clang pane on old issues where the successor front end may already
#    have answered the question -- here it has not, and the pane would be 13 errors of noise
#    about constructs unrelated to the issue. CASE 1 is why.
#
# 2. Clang's HLSL front end does NOT reject a semantic on a Texture2D entry-point parameter,
#    which is a datapoint for @tex3d's and @damyanp's position that this code should not be
#    accepted. CASE 2 measures that, and CASE 1 is its control: the same flags on the same
#    compiler do produce diagnostics when there is something it knows how to reject, so
#    CASE 2's clean exit is a real result and not `-fsyntax-only` doing nothing.
#    CASE 3 confirms the flags and shader stage work at all on a plainly valid shader.
#
# Limits: -fsyntax-only asks a front-end question only, and Clang's HLSL support is
# incomplete, so CASE 2 says Clang's Sema has no rule against this today -- not that Clang
# would compile it.
